incident-bot: PagerDuty alert flood detected for service=\"inference-serving\" — ~520 alerts/min, paging laura (oncall). Incident created: INC-2026-0317-15
Laura (oncall): I see timeouts across a few customers, getting details. Is this customer-visible? Anna (support) — any support tickets?
Anna (support): Support has 3 inbound tickets referencing elevated 5xxs and slow response times, one mentions model timeouts in prod region us-east-1.
Sam (sre): OK — likely a request fan-in causing queue/backpressure. First mitigation: reduce alert noise so oncall can act. Propose temporary grouping key change + 2-min rate limit in Alertmanager.
Miguel (alerts): Agreed. Quick plan: 1) enable grouping by fingerprint (error_class + model_variant) 2) set group_wait=30s, group_interval=2m, repeat_interval=1h 3) create a temp mute for non-customer-impacting alerts.
Tim (infra): I can flip a rate-cap in the alert router for 15m. Command to apply (api):
```
curl -XPOST https://alerts.internal/api/v1/ratecap -d '{"service":"inference-serving","limit_per_min":60,"duration_min":15}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ALERT_OPS"
```
Laura (oncall): Do it. Also let's mute noisy alert template `kv-cache-error-*` for 30m — those are cascades.
Miguel (alerts): Muted `kv-cache-error-*` in Alertmanager silence id=tmp-mute-176601. Adding dedupe fingerprint: `{{ $labels.error_code }}-{{ $labels.model }}` to routing key.
Sam (sre): Patch sent to alertmanager: routing tree now groups by `[error_code, model]`. Also temporarily lowered sensitivity on `latency_high` from 95th to 99th for 20m.
Tim (infra): Deploying a temporary autoscaler tweak to increase worker pool by +20% to absorb backlog. Rolling now — will post when done.
Laura (oncall): Confirming PagerDuty noise dropping — alerts down to ~40/min and grouped nicely. Thanks. Can we capture customer impact window?
Anna (support): Customer-impact window estimated 15:12 -> 15:28 UTC, ~16 customers experienced >5% error rate increase. Logging extracted to /incidents/INC-2026-0317-15/impact.csv
Miguel (alerts): Post-incident actions: 1) permanent dedupe rule by `error_code+model_variant` 2) add Grafana panel `alert_fan_in_rate` to track alerts/min by fingerprint 3) runbook update to include temporary ratecap and mute SOP 4) unit tests for new grouping behavior
Sam (sre): +1. Also propose an automated circuit-breaker: if alerts/min > 300 for 3m AND customer_error_pct < 1% then auto-squelch non-critical alerts. File a follow-up ticket.
Tim (infra): Filed TASK-1487 to add circuit-breaker + dashboard widget.
Laura (oncall): Thanks team. For now we've stabilized. Leaving a 1hr post-incident watch. Will add notes to the incident doc and schedule a short debrief at 17:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
